author: Matt Lenzie
scope: England and Wales category A records, 7 custom regional groups, 2023 Q1 to provisional 2026 Q3. Latest Q3 transaction 28 August; September absent. Source national medians retained, not independently recomputed.

derived_fields.source_national_median_gbp: Retained unadjusted England and Wales source median; not constant quality.
derived_fields.equal_mean_of_regional_medians_gbp: Arithmetic mean of seven regional medians; not pooled median or mean price.
derived_fields.count_weighted_mean_of_regional_medians_: sum(count*regional median)/sum(mapped regional counts); not pooled median or mean price.
derived_fields.equal_minus_source_gbp: Equal shortcut less retained national source median.
derived_fields.weighted_minus_source_gbp: Weighted shortcut less retained national source median.
derived_fields.weighted_difference_pct: 100*(weighted summary/source national median-1), not house-price growth.
derived_fields.synthetic_counterexample.csv: Invented teaching values only; no observed transaction data.
